title: Total Amount Auto-Sync from Registration to Payment QR Section

requirements.text: On the Register page, when the user clicks the 'Proceed to Payment' button, save the displayed total amount (numeric value, stripped of the ₹ symbol) to localStorage under the key 'vibecxAmount', then navigate to the Payment page. Use the existing totalAmount display element as the source value.

quotes: When user clicks 'Proceed to Payment': localStorage.setItem('vibecxAmount', amount);

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Proceed to Payment' writes the current total amount (without ₹) to localStorage key 'vibecxAmount'.
The value written matches exactly what is shown in the total amount display on the Registration page.
Navigation to the Payment page occurs after saving the value.

requirements.text: On the Payment page, on load, read the 'vibecxAmount' value from localStorage and display it as '₹<amount>' in the QR amount display element. Also populate a hidden input field with the raw numeric amount. No fee recalculation must occur on the Payment page — only the stored value must be used.

quotes: Payment page must NOT calculate again. Only use value received from Registration page.
QR scan screen must always show stored total amount.

acceptanceCriteria: On Payment page load, the QR section displays the amount as '₹<value>' where value matches what was saved by the Registration page.
A hidden input field holds the raw numeric amount from localStorage.
The Payment page performs no independent fee calculation.
If no amount is found in localStorage, the QR amount area is handled gracefully (e.g., shows a fallback or empty state).
The displayed QR amount is identical to the total shown on the Registration page before navigation.

constraints: The Payment page must not recalculate or derive the amount independently — it must only read from localStorage key 'vibecxAmount'.
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any files under frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Changing the fee calculation logic on the Registration page.
Persisting the amount to the backend.
Adding any new payment methods or QR code generation.
Modifying the screenshot upload or backend submission flow on the Payment page.
